correctness.description: Test `test_python_script_exists` passes: Test that the sync script exists with proper permissions and valid syntax.
Test `test_script_execution_succeeds` passes: Test that the sync script executes without errors.
Test `test_recent_users_synced_to_crm` passes: Test that recent users from PostgreSQL are synced to EspoCRM with correct field mapping.

functional.description: The solution connects to the PostgreSQL database to fetch user records
functional.rationale: Accessing the source data is the first step of the sync process.

functional.description: The solution connects to the EspoCRM API endpoint 'http://localhost:80' (or 'http://espocrm:80')
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution connects to the correct destination system.

functional.description: The solution filters users by 'created_at' timestamp (last 1 hour) in the database query
functional.rationale: Implementing the time-based filter is a key functional requirement.

functional.description: The solution creates new Contact records in EspoCRM for each qualified user
functional.rationale: Creating the contact records completes the sync operation.

robustness.description: The solution handles duplicate contacts gracefully (e.g., catching 409 Conflict errors)
robustness.rationale: Prevents the script from failing if run multiple times (idempotency).

robustness.description: The solution uses environment variables for sensitive configuration (DB URL, API credentials)
robustness.rationale: Security best practice; avoids hardcoding credentials.

robustness.description: The solution ensures the database connection is closed properly (e.g., using try/finally)
The solution handles database connection errors without crashing ungracefully
robustness.rationale: Ensures the script reports connection issues clearly.
